name: AnyHook API
description:
Webhook relay API with two surfaces:

**Management API** (/api/v1/) , create apps, query events, trigger replays. Authenticate with: Authorization: Bearer ahk_live_xxx

**Ingress** (https://in.anyhook.net/{user-slug}/{app-slug}) , receives webhooks from Stripe/GitHub/Shopify. No auth required; HMAC signature verified automatically.

**Typical agent workflow:**
1. Stripe or GitHub: POST /api/v1/connect with the provider key → the webhook is registered at the provider and verified from the first event (skip step 2)
   Other providers: POST /api/v1/apps → get inbound_url
2. Configure inbound_url in the provider's webhook settings
3. GET /api/v1/events?app_slug=xxx to monitor delivery
4. POST /api/v1/events/{id}/replay if delivery failed
5. DELETE /api/v1/apps/{slug} when done
